figures.caption: 圖：校園裡的植物觀察課
figures.description: 晴朗的日子，生物老師帶著學生在校園的大樹下上植物觀察課。左邊一個女生蹲在花圃旁，拿著放大鏡看小黃花；旁邊一個男生把一片樹葉舉高對著陽光，另一個男生在筆記本上畫樹葉；老師站在樹旁，指著樹幹上的名牌向學生說明；右邊一個女生拿著平板電腦，替樹叢的葉子拍照。

questions.stem: 提示：生物課有時會走出教室，讓學生到校園裡觀察植物。請仔細看下面的圖片，寫一篇英文作文，文分兩段。第一段描述圖中的學生們在植物觀察課上做哪些事；第二段寫出你自己上過的一次戶外課或觀察活動，並說明你喜歡或不喜歡在教室外上課的原因。

1.explanation_zh: 這一題有三個要求：第一段描述圖中學生在觀察課上的動作（用放大鏡看花、舉起葉子、畫筆記、用平板拍照、老師指著名牌說明）；第二段寫一次自己上過的戶外課或觀察活動，再說明喜歡或不喜歡在教室外上課的原因。喜歡或不喜歡都可以，重點是理由要和自己的經驗連在一起。
evidence: 第一段描述圖中的學生們在植物觀察課上做哪些事
說明你喜歡或不喜歡在教室外上課的原因
1.strategy_zh: 描述圖片時用 through a magnifying glass、with a tablet 這類「用什麼工具」的片語，句子會更具體；經驗段寫清楚地點、觀察到什麼、學到什麼。
hints: 第一段：On the left, a girl is looking at … through …
第二段：Last …, my class had an outdoor lesson in … 接觀察到的一件事
最後用 I like / I do not like having classes outside because … 回應題目

moves.zh: 描述圖中的學生們在植物觀察課上做哪些事
寫出你自己上過的一次戶外課或觀察活動
說明你喜歡或不喜歡在教室外上課的原因

content.focus_zh: 第一段寫出圖中至少三種觀察動作；第二段要有一次具體的戶外或觀察經驗（時間、地點、看到什麼），並說明喜歡或不喜歡在教室外上課的理由。

bands.descriptor_zh: 回應題目的每一項要求，主旨明確；用具體的事例、細節或親身經驗撐起每個重點。
大致回應題目，但有一項要求寫得單薄，或細節偏籠統、說服力不足。
漏掉題目的主要要求或主旨模糊，多數句子空泛、重複或偏離題目。
空白、離題、只抄題目，或內容少到無法判斷要說什麼。

organization.focus_zh: 第一段依位置描述，第二段依「經驗經過、學到什麼、喜歡與否的理由」排列；可以承認戶外課的缺點，再回到自己的立場，結尾要和前面的經驗呼應。

bands.descriptor_zh: 兩段分工清楚，各有主題句；句與句、段與段的銜接自然，轉承語用得恰當，篇幅分配合理。
段落大致分明，但有的地方跳接或重複，轉承語偏少或用得生硬。
重點排列混亂，前後句常接不起來，讀者不容易跟上。
看不出段落與順序，句子彼此無關。

grammar.focus_zh: 圖片用現在進行式、經驗用過去式；介系詞片語（through a magnifying glass、with a tablet）要放對位置。

bands.descriptor_zh: 句子幾乎沒有文法、標點錯誤，能交替使用簡單句、複句與不同的句首。
偶有時態、單複數或標點錯誤，但讀得懂意思；句型變化有限。
錯誤多到常讓人誤解意思，句子結構常不完整。
幾乎沒有正確的句子，無法理解。

vocabulary.focus_zh: 放大鏡、樹葉、筆記本、戶外課等字（magnifying glass、leaf／leaves、notebook、outdoor）要拼對；leaf 的複數是 leaves。

bands.descriptor_zh: 用字精準、貼切，搭配自然，少有重複；拼字與大小寫幾乎全對。
字彙範圍偏窄、常重複同幾個字，偶有用字不當或拼錯，但不妨礙理解。
用錯字或拼錯字很多，常讓人看不懂。
幾乎每個字都用錯或拼錯，無法理解。

rubric.deductions_zh: 字數明顯不足（少於 100 個單詞）或沒有分成兩段，各扣總分 1 分；兩種情形同時發生只扣 1 分。離題或空白以 0 分計。

sentence_starters: On the left, a girl is looking at ...
Last ..., my class had an outdoor lesson ...
I like having classes outside because ...

model_texts.label: steady
model_texts.text:
The picture shows a biology class under a big tree on campus. Instead of sitting in the classroom, the students are learning about plants outside. On the left, a girl is squatting by a flower bed and looking at some small yellow flowers through a magnifying glass. Next to her, one boy is holding up a leaf to the sunlight, and another boy is drawing a leaf in his notebook. Beside the tree, the teacher is pointing at the name tag on the trunk and explaining something to the class. Meanwhile, a girl on the right is taking photos of the leaves on a bush with a tablet.
Last spring, my class also had an outdoor lesson in the school garden. Our job was to watch how bees visit flowers. At first, I was afraid of the bees, but our teacher told us to stay calm and move slowly. Then I saw a bee with yellow powder on its legs flying from one flower to another. I like having classes outside because I can see real things, not just pictures in a book. For example, after watching that bee, I finally understood how flowers make seeds. Also, the fresh air keeps me awake and focused. However, outdoor classes can be difficult on rainy or very hot days. All in all, I hope we can have more lessons like this because they make learning fun.

self_assessment.explanation_zh: 圖中五個人的動作與自己的戶外經驗都寫到，理由有例子，也提到缺點（內容 4）；段落分工清楚，轉承語正確但變化不多（組織 4）；句子正確，以簡單句為主（文法句構 4）；用字正確但偏基礎（字彙拼字 3）。總分 15，屬穩健版。

model_texts.label: top
model_texts.text:
On a sunny day, the biology class in the picture has traded its classroom for the shade of a huge tree. Crouching beside a flower bed, a girl is examining some tiny yellow blossoms through a magnifying glass, as if she were a detective searching for clues. A few steps away, one boy is holding a leaf up to the light, while his partner is carefully sketching its outline in a notebook. Next to the trunk, the teacher is pointing to a name tag on the tree, connecting what the students see with what they have read in their textbooks. On the right, another girl is photographing the leaves of a bush with a tablet. Every student, it seems, has found a different way to look closely at nature.
Last October, I had a similar lesson when our biology teacher took us to a patch of grass behind the library. Each group marked out a square one meter wide with string, and our task was to count how many kinds of plants were growing inside it. At first, I expected to find only two or three types of grass, so the job seemed tedious and pointless. After forty minutes on our hands and knees, however, we had recorded eleven different kinds of plants, including some tiny clover hidden under taller leaves. That lesson gave me a fresh perspective, showing me how much I usually miss when I hurry across campus. Admittedly, lessons outside are not always comfortable, since mosquitoes and sudden showers can easily interrupt them. Some classmates also find it harder to concentrate without desks. Nevertheless, I prefer learning outdoors, because it turns facts from a textbook into things I can see and touch. Most importantly, it trains us to observe patiently and to trust evidence rather than guesses. Overall, the greatest value of an outdoor class lies not in the names of the plants we learn but in the habit of looking closely, which we can carry back into every classroom.

self_assessment.explanation_zh: 圖片描述有動作、工具與比喻，經驗段有方法、數據、意外的結果、讓步與見解（內容 5）；第一段的「仔細看」與第二段的經驗、結尾的見解前後呼應（組織 5）；分詞片語、as if、過去完成式、not…but 使用正確（文法句構 5）；crouching、clover、concentrate 等字用得精確，但整體以常用字為主（字彙拼字 4）。總分 19，屬頂標版。

steady.comment_zh: 第一段依位置寫出用放大鏡看小黃花、舉葉子對著陽光、畫葉子、老師指著名牌說明、用平板拍葉子，和圖相符；第二段有時間（last spring）、地點（school garden）與看到的事（腳上沾花粉的蜜蜂），並寫出喜歡戶外課的兩個理由與一個缺點，結尾回到希望多上這種課。時態與介系詞片語都正確，未見語言錯誤；句型與字彙正確但較基本，四項都給 4。taking photos of the leaves on a bush with a tablet 把 with a tablet 放在句末，語意清楚，不算錯。

top.comment_zh: 第一段描述精準又有畫面感（as if she were a detective searching for clues），五個人物的動作全部寫到，並用 Every student, it seems... 收束；第二段的一平方公尺樣區調查有時間、地點、步驟與結果（四十分鐘找到十一種植物），由原本以為很無聊的落差帶出收穫，再讓步（蚊子、陣雨、沒有桌子）後回到偏好，結尾點出「仔細觀察的習慣」並呼應經驗。句型多變（分詞構句、假設語氣、not...but...），用字精準（tedious、perspective、evidence），未見錯誤。

steady.comment_zh: 第一段寫出放大鏡觀察、舉葉子、畫葉子、老師講解名牌、拍照五項，與圖相符；第二段有去年春天在校園花園觀察蜜蜂的經驗與喜歡戶外課的理由，並提到下雨、太熱的缺點。結構清楚、時態正確、無錯誤；經驗的細節與反思略為簡單，句型與用字屬穩定而不特別突出。第一段末句的 with a tablet 的修飾位置稍易被誤讀為「有平板的灌木」，但以常識不致誤解，不計為錯。

top.comment_zh: 第一段觀察細緻且有創意（as if she were a detective）；第二段的樣方計數經驗有時間、地點、方法與數字（一平方公尺、四十分鐘、十一種），並寫出態度由預期無聊到改觀，再先讓步戶外課的缺點、回到自己立場，結尾呼應「仔細觀察」的習慣。句型多變，用字精準（tedious、perspective、clover），無錯誤。
